Then your pancreas may not be making enough digestive enzymes, called Exocrine Pancreatic Insufficiency, and you'd test for that with Stool Elastase and treat it with high-dose enzymes. new: So check your organs (Brown). Do your stools look oily or greasy? Then it's often your pancreas not making enough digestive enzymes, which doctors call Exocrine Pancreatic Insufficiency. A Stool Elastase test will tell you, and if that's it, you take high-dose enzymes with every meal. If it's diarrhea that keeps coming back instead, Brown says the issue can be Bile Acid Diarrhea, where too much of your bile reaches your colon. He has you tested for that with SeHCAT, and bile binders soak up the extra bile.
